data.narrative:
QuantumDiamonds is a seed-stage quantum computing company founded by Kevin Berghoff and Fleming Bruckmaier. The sector peer set comprises 3 public companies (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS) and 8 private firms including Quantinuum, IonQ, PsiQuantum, D-Wave Quantum, and SandboxAQ. The company has raised €7M in seed funding plus a €152M facility commitment.

The Stage-Progression method is the applicable triangulation approach. Using €7M in total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical for seed-to-next-stage advancement yields an implied valuation of €18M. Peer-Median comparison was not viable; while 8 quantum computing peers exist in the broader dataset, none met narrow-filter criteria (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier peers), falling below the minimum threshold of 3 comparable datapoints required for reliable median benchmarking.

The analysis supports a valuation range of €15M (low) to €20M (high), with a median of €18M. This range is anchored to a single method, which represents a material constraint on confidence. Key uncertainties include the absence of same-stage or adjacent-stage quantum computing comparables, the treatment of the €152M facility commitment (which may or may not translate to equity value), and the limited depth of the triangulation. Further resolution requires either identifying closer-stage peers or establishing clearer linkage between the facility commitment and enterprise value.
